rooms.9901: You stand inside the city limits of Ghenna, once a thriving barter town and now a haven for the evil it bred under the proud Lord Suzerain. Broken walls and fallen lintels crowd every corner, mixed with age-whitened bones of all manner of beasts. Streets lead away north toward a fountain, east and west into the ruined town, and south toward a graveyard stench.
rooms.9902: A great fountain stands here against the city wall, brimming with the tears of all who died within Ghenna. Strangely, the water is a clear and shining blue, and it gives off a holiness that sits oddly in so foul a place. The basin is wide and deep, ringed by cracked paving. A road climbs north, a cul-de-sac opens west, and the square falls away south toward the city limits.
rooms.9967: The road is narrow here, hemmed in by the city wall that blocks the way ahead. A fallen building slumps beside the road, its timbers bowed and black with damp. Grey weeds push between the cobbles, and the air tastes of rot. The road bends on east, while the street opens out and runs back south to the fountain.
rooms.9969: The road makes a tight bend here, squeezed between the tall city wall and a row of sagging shutters. Moss has crept over the stones and the gutters hold a thin brown ooze. A cold draught slips along the wall, carrying the smell of old smoke. A narrow lane runs south, and the road runs back west the way you came.
rooms.9968: A narrow lane runs between the towering city wall and the blind fronts of crooked houses. A single door hangs beneath a lamp that glows a dull and sullen red, staining the cobbles the colour of old wine. The paving is greasy underfoot. The lane goes on north toward a bend and south toward a wider street.
rooms.9966: This is a street of broken cobbles, with the city wall rising close beside it. Corpses lie sprawled along the gutters, so many that you must pick your steps with care. Flies drone over the stones and a cold wind rattles the loose slates above. The street runs north and west, while a covered walkway opens to the south.
rooms.9978: A covered walkway leads on into gloom, its timber roof black and beaded with moisture. The air here is so humid it hangs in visible veils between the posts. Wet planks sag underfoot and the lamps along it have long since died. The street lies open to the north, and a steep slick passage drops away downward into darkness.
rooms.9979: A footpath lies thick with a pale, ectoplasmic slime that shivers faintly as you step. It is so slippery that you cannot climb back toward the walkway above. Drips fall from the dank overhang, and the stench is sweet and awful. The only way onward is west along the glistening path.
rooms.9980: The slime grows thicker as the path goes on, a glossy skin over the ruts and stones. The bodies of beasts that slipped in and drowned lie half sunk in it, their bones showing through. The ooze sucks at your boots at every step. The footpath turns here, running north and back east.
rooms.9981: Slime lies everywhere on this stretch of path, and it is a thick and dark red where it pools in the hollows. The stones are furred with it, and it trails in ropes from the low branches overhead. It feels as though the ground itself bleeds. The footpath leads south and west.
rooms.9982: The slime thins out a little here, though the footpath is still as slick as wet glass. Patches of bare rock show through, spotted with pale mould. Ahead the trees draw back, and a clearing shows beyond the last bend. The path runs east the way you came and south toward the open ground.
rooms.9983: Here the slime gives out and the ground turns to hard red clay, dotted with a few lonely boulders. It is a rough, trampled track of some primitive sort, packed down by many feet. The sky is low and sullen over it. A dark opening in a rocky bank lies south, and the footpath leads back north.

9984.description: You stand at the mouth of a small cave, cut into the foot of a tall promontory of rock. The stone around the opening is stained and slick with seeping water. A rough-hewn stair leads down into the dark, damp throat of the hill. The clearing lies back north in the grey light.

9985.description: This small underground cavern is the dampest place imaginable. Moisture trickles down the smooth rock in rivulets and drips steadily from the ceiling onto your head. The air is warm and thick, and every sound echoes. A rough stair climbs back to the cave mouth, and a passage runs south into the dark.

9986.description: A long tunnel slopes gently away in the dark. The smooth rock sweats as if alive, and beads of water gather and run in the grooves of the floor. The air is hot and heavy with damp. The tunnel leads north toward the cavern and south deeper down.

9987.description: The tunnel continues to slope, its rounded walls slick with a cold shine of moisture. Small pools have gathered in dips of the floor and drip steadily. Somewhere ahead water trickles into a hollow. The passage runs north and south through the dark.

9988.description: The slope eases here, and the sweating rock closes in on both sides. A thin film of water covers the floor and your steps splash loudly. The ceiling hangs low and glistens in the faint light. The tunnel goes on south toward a wider place and back north.

9989.description: The tunnel opens into a T shape here, with passages leading east and west and the long slope running back north. The cavern is vaulted high above you, fully twenty-five feet of dark that swallows your light. Water ticks from unseen heights into shallow puddles. The air is cool and still.

9992.description: This tunnel is broader and easier to move through, but the turns have left you unsure of your bearings. The rock is rough here and worn into odd ridges. A hole in the rock opens to the south, and the tunnel leads north toward the cavern and west toward a junction.

9993.description: You squeeze into a low crawlspace that is thick with insects, and they crunch beneath your weight with every move. Dark husks and tangled webs coat the rock. The ceiling presses on your back and the air is close and sour. The crawl runs south into a hollow, and back north to the wide tunnel.

9994.description: The crawlspace opens into a square hollow about ten feet across, thick with the husks and trails of countless insects. Webs hang in grey curtains from the low ceiling and the floor shifts with unseen movement. The smell is dry and bitter. Ways lead north into the crawl, east toward a pile of bones, and west into a trembling passage.

9953.description: You lie beneath a loose heap of stacked bones, a barrow of the unburied. Through the empty eye socket of a human skull above you, a pale night sky shows. The bones shift and clatter with every breath. With a small effort you could free yourself and climb up out of the pile.

rooms.9903: This is the town graveyard, if such a name can be given to it. Nobody troubles to bury the dead in Ghenna, so corpses lie strewn about in no kind of order, and the stench is overwhelming. Heaped bodies close off the way along the far side. A road leads north to the city limits, a hedge maze lies south, and a street opens west.
rooms.9905: You are among a row of twisting hedges, seven feet tall, dense and dark and cut into winding turns. Thorny shoots lean over the path as if listening. The leaves are glossy with damp and smell like old cellars. The hedge walls close in all round, and the only way through leads west.
rooms.9998: The street comes to a dead end in a twisted mass of black brambles that spills over the cobbles. The high city wall looms over you, close and moss-streaked. Rot-sweet air gathers in the thorny corner. The only ways out are north along the street and east into the hedges.
rooms.9954: The street runs between stained house fronts, the high city wall blocking the way beyond. The paving is cracked and sunken, with pools of black water in the dips. Shutters bang somewhere in the dark. The street leads on north and south, and a lane opens east.
rooms.9955: A street runs north and south here, its cobbles battering your feet with every step. The tall city wall stands close beside it. A burned-out building leans nearby, barely upright in the thin wind that whistles through. Charred beams show against the sky, and you can go north, south, or east into the ruin.
rooms.9957: You are on a corner of the street, with the city wall rising close at hand. A shuttered doorway stares out from the stones across the way, bolted and silent. Dead leaves and ash drift in the corner. From here the street runs east toward the city limits and south along the wall.
rooms.9956: Charred rubble fills this ruined shell, and a fallen beam lies across a skeleton bleached white with age. Soot clings to what remains of the walls, and ash lies in drifts over the floor. The whole place creaks and could crumble at any moment. The cobbled street lies back west through the broken doorway.
rooms.9951: The cobbled road is slick with the blood of many a wayward adventurer, and your boots slide on it. Dark stains run in the cracks and into the gutters. Ragged house fronts lean in on either side. The street goes on east toward the graveyard smell and west into the streets of the town.
rooms.9995: You have entered a quivering passage that feels like the inside of some vast beast. The walls are a deep red and thrum with a slow, sick energy, and a warm wet breath moves along them. The floor gives under each step like a soft cushion. The only way out leads north.
rooms.9996: The whole passage heaves so much that you can scarcely keep your feet. Red mucus hangs from the ceiling and walls in dark, dripping strings that make your stomach turn. The air is hot and sweetish, and a low pulse beats in the floor. A darker patch in the wall hints at the only way on, leading west.
rooms.9997: This is a lair some twenty feet across, its corners drifted with bones, most of them plainly human. A great heap of treasure lies in the middle of the floor, slick with the same red mucus that coats the walls. The air is close and warm and thick with a deep rot. Ways lead east toward a heap of bones, south into a heaving chamber, and west to a damp cavern, while a dark way drops downward.
rooms.9911: The room undulates with an aura of terrible evil. The floor shifts under your feet so that you stagger, and the ceiling pumps slowly above you like a great muscle. You feel your strength draining from your limbs. Passages lead east toward a spinning place and south into a red realm.
rooms.9924: You are caught in a swirling vortex of time that turns your stomach. You spin and spin, unsure which way is which, and the colours smear into a grey blur around you. It seems you could end up in any of several places. Ways lead east, south, and west, and a gap in the floor drops down toward a street.
rooms.9925: You stand within a labyrinth made of bodies stacked ten feet high, forming crooked corridors of limbs and cloth. Some of them are still warm, and now and then a cry of despair rises from the mass. The air is thick with the smell of death. No path out can be seen.
rooms.9914: This is a plain and ordinary street, rolling gently over a shallow dale. Dark windows watch from both sides and a damp wind pushes old rags along the gutter. The road leads east toward a small circle of stones, and west toward a musty gap behind a wall.
rooms.9904: A small cul-de-sac circles here on worn cobbles. A large fountain glimmers just beyond the street, east of the circle, and a door lies to the north beneath a tavern sign painted with something unspeakable. The sign swings and creaks on rusted chains. The street leads back west.
rooms.9915: You stand inside Blood Tavern, a bizarre place at first sight. The parquet floor creaks beneath an odd and shifting bar, and next to the bar a stairwell vanishes upward into blackness. The ceiling is vaulted, with three candled chandeliers that hang like victims overhead. A card table stands to the north, and the door leads back out south.
rooms.9917: A card table made from the skeleton of some odd four-legged thing stands here, with a few unplayed hands left on it. You wonder where the rest of the poor players went. The room is dim and smells of tallow and old wine. The tavern floor lies south, and the bar rises to the north.
rooms.9916: A long bar runs along the room, built of God knows what, and it seems to be made of pale hide sewn with the hair of various beasts. Sturdy though it is, it is pliant to the touch and seems to move ever so slightly, as if alive. A dark stairwell leads upward from here. The card table lies back south.
rooms.9918: You stand at the top of the stairs in Blood Tavern. A small hallway runs east and west in darkness, its boards sagging and warped. Cold air seeps through the gaps in the plaster. Stairs lead down to the bar below.
rooms.9919: This is a small upstairs hallway, narrow and low, with a sour smell of old smoke. Behind the door to the north you hear faint singing, a dusky voice that sounds almost feminine. The planks creak with each step. The top of the stairs lies back west.
rooms.9920: A messy bedroom holds a badly stained bed and a simple roll-top desk buried in dusty papers. A small window looks out over darkness. The sheets lie in a tangle, and the air is stale with old perfume. The only door leads south to the hallway.
rooms.9921: This upstairs hallway of Blood Tavern is dim and bare, with a threadbare runner on the boards. A door stands to the south, closed against the dark. The plaster has peeled in long strips, showing the laths beneath. The top of the stairs lies east.
rooms.9922: This is the master suite of Blood Tavern. A liquor cabinet stands against one wall, full of dusty old bottles, and a king-sized bed faces it across the room. Heavy curtains keep out all light. A half-open door leads west into a washroom, and another leads back north to the hall.
rooms.9923: The washroom stinks of damp and old rot. A basin sits on the floor, filled with water that is stained dark red, and a dirty mirror reflects your face back at you in fragments. The tiles are cracked and sticky. A door leads east to the suite, and another to the north opens on a musty gap.
rooms.9943: You are in a musty hidden space behind the wall of the washroom. Dust lies thick and grey on the boards, and spider silk hangs in ropes. A very narrow granite staircase leads down from here into darkness. A door lies south.
rooms.9946: You are on a narrow granite staircase that spirals gently downward. The stone is worn into hollows by long use and slick with damp. A thin cold draught climbs the shaft from below. You may go up toward the hidden space or down into the dark.
rooms.9945: The granite staircase winds on, its steps narrow and uneven, worn hollow in the middle by long use. Faint scratches mark the stone where something once dragged itself along. The darkness below smells of old wine and wet brick. You may climb back up or descend further.
rooms.9944: You have reached the bottom of the granite staircase, the cellar of Blood Tavern. A hole in the ceiling is stained black, above a great heap of refuse and rotting sacking. Walls stand close on every other side, but a way passes east around the heap. The stair rises back up.
rooms.9947: This niche behind the back wall is dank, dark and dusty. The brick shows the signs of decay, red and black flakes littering the floor. An old cask of port lies broken in one corner, a relic from happier times. A door leads north, and the way back lies west.
rooms.9948: You land in a heap beside a small hole in the floor, and a smell of cooking drifts up out of it. The stone is hot under your hands. A dull red glow shows from the passage ahead. Ways lead north into the glow, east through a door, and south back to the niche.
rooms.9949: You seem to have stepped into a little corner of hell. Flames dance on the walls and make the light play tricks on your eyes. A dark figure can just be made out to the north. The way south leads back the way you came.
rooms.9952: Fire rages on every side. A black marble dais rises among the flames, bearing a black marble chair that is conspicuously empty. It is plainly a throne of some sort. The flames make every way impassable but the one you came by, to the south, and a holy way that climbs upward.
rooms.9950: A cot lies against the far wall of this small alcove, directly beneath an inverted pentagram scribed in dark red. A bound footlocker stands opposite. The air is stale and tinged with sulfur. The only exit is the door back west.
rooms.9910: The wailing of souls in torment sends shivers up your spine. The walls, floor and ceiling are a thick red mass that defies description. A rift in the ceiling lets down a slight breeze that ruffles your hair. A way leads north into a heaving room, and a gap rises overhead toward the city limits.

9990.description: This tunnel is barely five feet high, a stoop to walk in. Moss-like lichens hang from the ceiling and brush your face from time to time. The rock is wet and cold to the touch. The tunnel continues east and west.

9991.description: The cramped tunnel runs on to a huge boulder that fills it from side to side. Gaps beside the stone show a drift of old bones beyond. Cold air stirs through the cracks. The tunnel leads back east, and a narrow squeeze past the boulder goes west.

rooms.9960: So much filth litters the street here that you must zigzag around it. A bare doorframe is all that remains of the house on the south side, standing alone in a heap of broken stone. The house to the north looks a little more whole. The street goes on a long way west, and runs east toward a heap of rubble and the city wall.
rooms.9961: This was once the trading post, a hall as large as an auditorium. A dais stands at the far end with a toppled podium upon it, and wooden benches lie tipped over in every reach of the floor. Dust and cobwebs mask the long tables where bargains were struck. The cobbled street lies just beyond the doorway to the south.
rooms.9962: This place was once a lovely home. The furniture is smashed to splinters, though it still hints at a grand and stately age, and cushions lie slit and spilled across the floor. A rickety stair climbs to the upper floor but does not look safe. The street lies through the door to the north.
rooms.9963: Things look no better on the upper floor. The ceiling has caved in on both sides and buried the passages under rotting beams, and foul mildew has grown thick over the debris. A door hangs by one hinge at the north end of the landing. The stair leads down.
rooms.9964: This was evidently a child's room. Broken toys lie scattered over the boards, and a mattress leans against the far wall, slashed down the middle with its stuffing heaped on the floor. A small painted horse lies on its side with its legs snapped. A closet door gapes to the west, and the landing lies back south.
rooms.9965: This is a small walk-in closet, hung with children's clothes that are stiff with mildew. Shoe boxes lie crushed and scattered on the floor, and the shelves have been torn from the plaster. A hatch in the floor leads down into a heaving place. The only other way is back east.
rooms.9959: The narrow street is dim, with only a smear of light from far overhead. Rubble from fallen houses chokes every side alley and spills into the gutters. The street runs east into deeper darkness and west toward the city entrance.
rooms.9906: Twisting hedges stand seven feet tall on every side, cut into narrow, winding turns. Black thorns jut from the branches and the ground is spongy with fallen leaves. The air smells of rot and damp earth. Each turn looks the same as the last, and the green walls mutter in the wind.
rooms.9907: You are lost among tall hedges whose dark leaves fold back on themselves. The path forks and doubles around you, and a pale fungus grows in the shade at the roots. A faint sweetness hangs in the air. Somewhere a branch cracks, but nothing can be seen through the leaves.
rooms.9908: The hedges here are old and woody, their trunks as thick as a man's arm and knotted with thorn. The path turns sharply and turns again, and a scatter of small bones lies in the dust of one bend. A grey mist drifts low along the ground. Overhead only a strip of sullen sky is visible.
rooms.9909: A maze of hedges encloses you, dense and glossy and tall. Dead leaves lie ankle deep, and strands of torn cloth hang from the thorns. The path loops round on itself so many times that you cannot say which way is which. A cold wind combs through the branches with a dry whisper.
rooms.9926: You are standing within a labyrinth made of bodies stacked ten feet high. Some are still warm, and now and then a moan of despair rises from the mass. The passages bend like the coils of a maze, and the smell is thick enough to taste.
rooms.9927: A wall of stacked bodies rises ten feet on every hand, packed tight in crooked rows. Some are still warm, and a long moan of despair comes from deep inside. Clammy air presses on your face. The corridor curls away and doubles back on itself.
rooms.9928: Corpses are piled ten feet high to form this twisting passage. A few of them are still warm, and from somewhere within the mass comes a muffled scream. A cold sweat of fear runs down your back. The floor is slick and uneven under your feet.
rooms.9929: The labyrinth of bodies is stacked ten feet high here, and pale limbs hang across the path. Some of the bodies are still warm, and a thin plea for aid sounds from the heap. The air is heavy and tastes of copper. The turns of the passage seem to shift as you watch.
rooms.9930: This stretch of the labyrinth is built of bodies stacked ten feet high, leaning together overhead. Some are still warm, and a gurgling cry of despair bubbles from the mass. The floor is wet and the dim light is the colour of old tallow. Every turn leads to another turn.
rooms.9931: You stand in a narrow lane between stacks of bodies ten feet tall. Some are still warm, and a shriek of horror breaks from the pile and dies away. The stack sways a little as if breathing. The path winds on among the dead with no end in sight.
rooms.9932: The passage between the stacked bodies narrows here, rising ten feet on either side. Some of the dead are still warm, and an occasional cry of despair stirs the silence. A faint draught from a doorway carries the smell of old sheets and stale scent. A way leads west out of the stack.

9933.description: Out of the labyrinth at last, you stand at the mouth of a large cave about a hundred feet across. A steady trickle of blood runs down worn stone steps that climb into the hill above. The rock is stained dark and the air is hot and sour. Dare you go up?

9934.description: You are inside the cave entrance, where a strong smell of sulfur makes you gag. Great stone steps lead down to the place of stacked bodies. A steady stream of blood trickles from somewhere to the north, where a sound like a giant bellows can be heard. A narrow ledge climbs up into a cramped hollow.

9935.description: The reek of sulfur grows stronger here, and about a hundred horribly disfigured corpses lie across the floor of rock. It looks as though the flesh was eaten from their bodies while they still lived. The stream of blood from the entrance is much wider here. The cave leads north toward the source and south back toward the entrance.

9936.description: This is an arched cavern of great size, high as a cathedral. A ledge of rock juts out far overhead and sends down a steady gush of blood and entrails. A raucous sound of crunching and a slurp here and there turns your stomach. A rough slope climbs on to a ledge, and a passage leads back south.

9937.description: This ledge is slippery with the blood of hundreds who came here and did not leave. Corpses lie everywhere, and a black steaming substance smeared over the rock gives off the awful sulfur smell. You feel certain your life may end soon. A slope leads down, and a bone-choked hollow opens above.

9938.description: You are in a cramped grotto over the cave entrance. Even if you are not afraid of tight places, this one will make you so. The rock presses close on every side and you must keep your head down. A crawlspace leads west, and a ledge drops down to the entrance.

9939.description: The grotto widens into an adit tall enough to stand in. Stalagmites and stalactites jut from floor and ceiling like the teeth of a great jaw. Water drips with a slow, steady beat. A passage leads north, and the narrow grotto lies back east.

9940.description: This crawlspace is barely passable. It bends to the right, and you cannot tell where it leads. The rock is close, rough and warm against your shoulders. A glow of lamplight spills in from the east, and there is no way back the way you came.

rooms.9941: You have entered the magical abode of a great efreeti, done in a style from far-off lands. The room glimmers with every comfort a being could want: pillows, rugs and brass candelabra are everywhere, and silk hangs from the ceiling. A heavy sweet incense hangs in the warm air. A narrow crawl leads out west, and a stair of bones rises upward.

9902.description: The basin is filled with clear blue water said to be the tears of those slain in Ghenna. It looks deep and wide, and it seems untouched by the filth around it.

9952.description: A black marble chair stands on a black marble dais. It is cold to look at, though fire licks at its feet, and it is conspicuously empty.
